note: Set A and Set B contain the same 17 claims with identical entities, attributes, values, conditions and quotes; only the ordering of two claims differs. Both therefore capture the same correct facts (spar cap and trailing-edge reinforcement materials, skin triaxial, shear web sandwich construction, aft shear web ~50% span) and share the same defects. Both include an unsupported blade length of 135 m and a weakly supported 130 m length read off the Z-axis, plus repeated statements of the same material facts and shading/thickness claims.
remarks: The two sets are content-identical, so the comparison is a tie. Neither set states a blade length in the text layer; the 135 m value is not supported anywhere on the page (the Z-coordinate axis runs to about 130 m), and the 130 m claim is an inference from the plot axis rather than a stated dimension. Both sets also repeat the spar cap and trailing edge reinforcement material facts three times each and treat figure shading ('green/blue shading') as a physical thickness value, which is a visualization convention, not a thickness. Important facts both sets miss: the main and aft shear webs are shown in red in Figure 14, and the modal frequencies in Table 6 (standstill, HAWCStab2) are referenced but not extracted.
